| description =  Gregor Nasin is one of the top bartenders in Freeport. A dedicated man, he is very devoted to remaining at the top of his profession.

A true professional, he is very willing to pass on to the beginner an excellent and mystical book "The Barkeeps compendium" if you can help supply him with some ingredients that he needs to practice some new recipes.

Gregor's personal quest for exotic recipes means that he would like a Kiola Nut, Eruds tonic, Honey Jum, and a Koalindl fish corpse. If you can retrieve these items for him, he'll reward you with the barkeeps compendium.

Co-incidentally, an Ogre named Clurg in Oggok has a desperate desire for that book (and I believe that he's the author).
